data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 11.1 million, representing 3.07% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This deterioration was primarily driven by increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims within the Property division, adverse development in Political Risk, and additional reserve strengthening for the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account within the Specialty division. The overall strengthening occurred despite a recognised net profit of GBP 14.2 million on the closure of the 2012 Year of Account, which was attributed to favourable performance in the MAT division.
